playbooks.title: Password reset
steps: Enter the work email tied to your Ociana account.
Open the reset email (check spam) and set a new password that meets the policy.
Sign in again. If it still fails after one successful reset, ask me to open a ticket.
playbooks.escalation_hint: If reset email never arrives, or login still fails after a successful reset, I can create a Jira ticket for Identity & Access.

playbooks.title: Account unlock
steps: Wait 15 minutes — temporary lockouts often clear automatically.
Confirm you are using the correct work email (not a personal alias).
Try Forgot password if you may have mistyped the password repeatedly.
If the account stays locked after 15 minutes, ask me to create a ticket.
playbooks.escalation_hint: Persistent lockouts need Identity & Access — I can open a Jira ticket.

playbooks.title: MFA / authenticator help
steps: Confirm the device clock is set to automatic time (wrong time breaks codes).
Open your authenticator app and use the newest code for Ociana / GSTS SSO.
If you lost the device, say "create ticket for MFA reset" and I will open an Identity & Access ticket.
playbooks.escalation_hint: Lost-device MFA resets always need a human-approved ticket.

playbooks.title: Page / session glitches
steps: Clear site cookies for the Ociana domain, then sign in again.
If the issue continues on another browser/network, ask me to open a ticket with the URL and approximate time.
playbooks.escalation_hint: Include the page URL and time of the issue when escalating.
